name: GIRDER 格拉德 Bison press-fit T700/T800 Ultegra R8020
why_interesting: The earlier ROAD-section BISON: mechanical Ultegra R8020 2×11 hydraulic on a T700 + T800 BB386 integrated frame with unbranded 50/60 mm carbon wheels at an official ¥14,800 and a 7.8 kg claim.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra R8020 mechanical 2×11 per the specification table; FC-R8000 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R8000 11-32T cassette; chain not listed. The page's intro text instead describes a Shimano 105 R7100 mechanical 2×12 group and names the AERO TEAM
facts.frame: ROAD-section BISON T700 + T800 carbon 'integrated' frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: BB386 press-fit system, 46 mm × 86 mm per the manufacturer's BB row
facts.wheels: T700 carbon wavy-rim wheels, 50 mm front / 60 mm rear, straight-pull ceramic-bearing hubs, Center Lock rotors; wheel brand not stated
facts.tires: Maxxis M228 700C×28C skinwall folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing
facts.sizes: S (448 mm), M (459 mm), L (497 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated

missing: Which groupset is actually supplied (specification table Ultegra R8020 2×11; intro text 105 R7100 2×12)
